decision.summary: Garden request stuck at landlord approval since January. A note says a £500+VAT quote was approved, but there is no recorded landlord words. I sent the landlord an SMS yes/no, told the tenant, and held the ticket with a review on 18 March.

answers.question: Where does this case stand, and what is outstanding?
answers.answer: At the landlord gate. A £500+VAT quote is noted as approved (event 009) but there is no landlord statement on record and the landlord hasn't responded to the email or calls. Outstanding: a clear landlord decision, then assignment.

answers.question: What is the next action, who is it for, and through which channel?
answers.answer: SMS to Jenkins (landlord) asking for a yes/no, plus an email to the tenant with status. Hold and follow-up set for 18 March.

answers.question: Does anything need a human decision?
answers.answer: Not yet. This is routine and the landlord has now been contacted on a second channel. If still silent after 18 March, escalate to maintenance P3.

conflicts: Event 009 says landlord approved the quote, but event 010 says get funds up front and later events say still waiting for the landlord; no landlord words on record, so approval was treated as not established.

tickets.description:
Hi dear Maintenance team,
As this garden is part of the house included in our tenancy, we would like it to be cleaned and finished properly. The ground also needs to be levelled and covered with stones (gravel) so that we can use the space safely. We would like to sit there in the afternoon, but at the moment it is not possible due to the condition.

I have attached pictures for your reference. Could you please arrange:
• Removal of all rubbish and construction waste
• Levelling of the ground
• Proper gravel/stone covering
• Making the garden safe and usable
